newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products start steady to slightly weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products start steady to slightly weaker.

text.p: NWE oil products were unchanged to slightly weaker in early trade on Friday, traders said.

Spot gas oil prices were off 25 cents in line with softer benchmark gas oil futures. Traders said barge premiums to the IPE screen were stable with bids for prompt lifting refinery material around June IPE +$1.50 and offers at +$2. Storage material was pegged around 50-75 cents under refinery values.
Lengthy supplies saw diesel barge premiums slightly weaker at around June IPE +$8/+$9.50 a tonne for delivery by June 15.
Eurograde gasoline barges talked unchanged at around $203/$205 a tonne fob ARA for June 1-15 liftings.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were slightly weaker in early trade at $80.25 fob Rotterdam refinery by June 15.
Later traders saw good selling around $81.50-$82 and buying at $80-$80.50 fob ARA.
